activity_statements.statement: operates Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and Messenger serving billions of users globally through free, advertising-supported social networking platforms
sells advertising inventory across Facebook and Instagram enabling businesses to reach targeted audiences using data-driven ad-placement systems
develops mixed-reality hardware and software including Meta Quest VR headsets and Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses for immersive consumer experiences
invests in and develops large-scale AI systems including generative AI models, the Meta AI assistant and AI infrastructure at scale for use across its platforms
operates extensive AI data center infrastructure built and owned by Meta to power its AI and platform operations globally
provides commerce and business tools enabling small and medium businesses to advertise, sell and connect with customers through its platforms

segments.name: Family of Apps (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger)

name_reality_gap: Labeled Software Development; Meta is primarily an advertising-revenue business — over 97% of revenue comes from selling targeted ad placements, making it more accurately described as a digital advertising marketplace that uses social software as the delivery mechanism for ad inventory.
extraction_notes: Clear source. Revenue split (advertising vs. Reality Labs) drawn from public knowledge consistent with source framing. AI data center investment confirmed in source via news reference.
